C0.quote: players form coalitions, and the coalition with the largest cumulative weight takes first prize
C0.note: The paper is about cooperative coalition-formation games with externalities (partition function games): stability, core, efficiency and complexity of payoff division among players competing for prizes. It does not study a voting rule that aggregates agents' submitted inputs into a collective decision. Weighted voting games appear only as the origin of the weight structure, so the paper is ineligible and coding stops.
